title: Demis Hassabis, CEO of Google DeepMind, on what skills will become more valuable in the AI era🧑‍💻
transcript: What human skills do you think get more valuable as AI just increasingly gets more capable? Well, I think it's very clear in the certainly in the short term. It's harder to predict out, you know, 10 years from now, but I would say in the next 5 years, it's very obvious to me that taste, design sensibility, original thinking, uh being able to synthesize different subjects together. But I think being quite broad-minded in your knowledge and skills. People who are kind of creative and technical, people like yourself, I think they're going to be in an amazing position uh with these technical tools, but then combining it with creativity. Whether that's in in the arts form or the science form. You know, I've always said that what separates the great scientist from the good scientist is not their technical capability cuz if you're a professional scientist, you're obviously very good technically. It's their creative capability. Their sort of taste and judgment. Also, um connecting with your audience, whether you're building a product or making a film or game, you know, how do you really connect emotionally with the other human beings that you're making this for. That isn't going to come from the tool, the AI tools. I think that's going to come from the from the human creator and the human expert.
